comparisons.title: Search surfaces first: the rule finds the watch.
comparisons.goal: Find a watch and put it on the side table.

changes.label: Input
changes.right: Task + 3 rules from the library (full text below)

changes.label: What happens
changes.left: Opens every drawer, twice; never looks at the coffee table
changes.right: Checks armchair, sofa, coffee table: watch found after 6 actions

comparisons.interpretation: Same game, no library vs. library. The watch lies on the coffee table, a surface. C spends its whole budget opening and re-opening drawers. E was given a learned procedure that says to search surfaces before containers; after one empty drawer it follows exactly that order and finds the watch.

beats.label: Start
beats.title: Same room, same goal
beats.text: Both agents must put a watch on the side table. The watch is on the coffee table.

beats.label: Search
beats.title: Drawers vs. surfaces
beats.text: C works through the drawers. E, following its rule, moves on to surfaces: armchair, sofa, coffee table.

beats.label: Found
beats.title: E picks up the watch
beats.text: E takes the watch from the coffee table. C is checking its inventory and revisiting drawers.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.title: Outcome
beats.text: C runs out of its 30 actions without ever seeing the watch. E delivers it in 8 actions.

comparisons.title: Go to the target before each placement.
comparisons.goal: Find two tissue boxes and put both on the toilet.

changes.label: Input
changes.right: Task + 3 rules from the library (full text below)

changes.label: What happens
changes.left: Searches 7 drawers; later tries to place the 2nd box on the toilet while standing at the countertop (refused)
changes.right: Countertop first; walks to the toilet before each placement

changes.label: Result
changes.left: 1 of 2 boxes placed; goal not met in 30 actions

comparisons.interpretation: Same game, no library vs. library. C makes the two mistakes the rules describe: it searches drawers before surfaces, and it tries to place a box without first walking to the toilet, so the command is refused and the budget runs out. E was given both rules and its trace follows them step by step.

beats.label: Start
beats.title: Same room, same goal
beats.text: Two tissue boxes must go on the toilet. Three are on the countertop, one is in a drawer.

beats.label: Search
beats.title: Drawers vs. surface
beats.text: C opens drawers one by one. E goes straight to the countertop, as rule_6 says.

beats.label: First box
beats.title: Both place one box
beats.text: C finds a box in drawer 5 and places it. E places its first box from the countertop.

beats.label: Mistake
beats.title: Placing from the wrong spot
beats.text: C takes a box at the countertop and immediately tries to move it to the toilet without walking there: refused. E walks to the toilet first (rule_17).

beats.label: Outcome
beats.title: Outcome
beats.text: C ends with one box placed. E places both in 8 actions.

comparisons.title: Follow the recipe: 14 actions become 3.
comparisons.goal: Hold the bowl with the desk lamp turned on.

changes.label: Input
changes.right: Task + 2 rules from the library (full text below)

changes.label: What happens
changes.left: Puts the bowl down, turns on the lamp, examines the desk 8 times, picks the bowl up again
changes.right: Takes the bowl, turns on the lamp: done

comparisons.interpretation: Same game, no library vs. library. Both succeed, so here the library saves effort rather than rescuing a failure. Without a procedure, C is unsure what “look at the bowl under the lamp” requires and loops on examine. E’s rule gives the order: hold the object at the lamp, switch it on. The goal is met as soon as the lamp is on.

beats.label: Start
beats.title: Same room, same goal
beats.text: Look at the bowl under the desk lamp. Bowl and lamp are both on desk 1.

beats.label: Pick up
beats.title: Both take the bowl
beats.text: Both agents pick up the bowl from the desk.

beats.label: Decision
beats.title: Put it down vs. use the lamp
beats.text: C puts the bowl back down. E, still holding the bowl, turns on the lamp and the goal is met.

beats.label: Outcome
beats.title: Outcome
beats.text: C loops on examining the desk and only finishes after picking the bowl up again: 14 actions vs. 3.

selection_policy: New E episodes must succeed; recorded C baselines may fail.
